# Architecture / design template

[한국어](../i18n/ko/templates/design.md) · [Documentation policy](../development/documentation-policy.md)

Template only. Replace prompts with evidence and identify the design's current status. Remove inapplicable sections or explain why they do not apply.

## Overview

State the purpose, implementation status, related Issue, Milestone and PR.

## Motivation

Describe the concrete problem and why existing behavior is insufficient.

## Requirements

List verifiable functional, resource, operational and security requirements.

## Non-goals

Bound the change and name capabilities that remain unavailable.

## Current Architecture

Describe the relevant current components and source contracts.

## Proposed Design

Explain responsibilities, interfaces, data flow, state and failure handling. Distinguish proposed changes from implemented ones.

## Trust Boundaries

Name assets, callers, authority, untrusted inputs and enforcement owners.

## Alternatives & Trade-offs

Compare realistic alternatives and explain the decision, cost and recovery implications.

## Compatibility

Describe API, protocol, database, data-lifecycle and supported-environment impact, including rollback constraints.

## Acceptance Criteria

Define measurable completion conditions and the tests that establish them.

## Open Questions

Record unresolved decisions, dependencies and owners. Use a reasoned not-applicable statement if none remain.

## References

Link the Issue, PR, specifications, threat model and validation evidence. Add the reciprocal translation link to the finished document.
